meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: Claude 会按步骤接入一个 Mattermost 机器人频道:先探测可复用的服务器、设置 SiteURL、复制适配器代码、认证 bot 令牌与回调地址、解析你的私聊,再构建、跑测试并重启 NanoClaw。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Mattermost 频道(自建或云端机器人)时触发。它会先探测已有服务器;没找到就让你先按 Mattermost 官方指引把服务器跑起来。

say.text: 帮我添加一个 Mattermost 频道。
say.note: 会先探测本机是否有可用服务器。

say.text: 我的 Mattermost 用户名是 alice,帮我打开和机器人的私聊。
say.note: 会解析该用户并建立 DM。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Mattermost bot channel: it probes for a reusable server, sets SiteURL, copies the adapter, authenticates a bot token and callback URL, resolves your DM, then builds, tests and restarts NanoClaw.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Mattermost channel (self-hosted or cloud) to NanoClaw. It probes for an existing server first, and points you to official setup guidance if none is running.

say_en.text: Add a Mattermost channel for me.
say_en.note: It probes for a healthy local server first.

say_en.text: Use https://mattermost.example.com as the Mattermost server.
say_en.note: It sets that URL as SiteURL and proceeds.

say_en.text: My Mattermost username is alice; open my DM with the bot.
say_en.note: It resolves the user and opens the shared DM.
